requirements.requirement: The system must validate that Phase I input maps to the lowest defined numeric score.
The system must validate that Phase II input maps to a higher numeric score than Phase I.
The system must validate that Phase III input maps to a higher numeric score than Phase II.
The system must validate that Phase IV input maps to the highest defined numeric score.
The system must validate that 'N/A' or equivalent non-phase input maps to a defined default or null score.
The system must validate that the mapping function returns a numeric value within the normalized scoring range.
The system must validate deterministic behavior such that identical phase inputs always return identical scores.
The system must validate that lowercase or case-variant inputs (e.g., 'phase i', 'PHASE II') are correctly normalized and mapped to the expected score.
The system must validate that unexpected phase input values (e.g., 'Phase V') do not cause runtime errors and return a safe default or null score.
The system must validate that null or missing phase input does not cause failure and returns a safe default or null score.
The system must validate that the score ordering preserves monotonic increase from Phase I through Phase IV.
The system must validate that no phase input produces a score outside the defined bounds of the scoring schema.
